mechanism_narrative: With no active stay-at-home orders, the retail recovery is capped by residual work-from-home policy; WORKPLACES below -40 signals continued office vacancy that prevents retail footfall recovery, so RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays below -40 but RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in TRANSIT from depressed levels is a leading indicator of restored retail mobility; if TRANSIT rises more than 5 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next four weeks.
